newsitem.title: RUSSIA: KomiTEK, Nobel Oil win small Russian oil tender.
newsitem.headline: KomiTEK, Nobel Oil win small Russian oil tender.

text.p: Russian oil firm KomiTEK and joint venture Nobel Oil have won a tender to carry out exploration work on three oil-bearing structures in the Arctic Komi Republic, Interfax news agency said on Tuesday.
Komi's Natural Resource and Environment Ministry had offered up for tender the West-Synatysk, South-Oshsk and South-Badiysk structures, it said, quoting a ministry source.
Nobel Oil is a joint venture between Swiss trading company Glencore International AG, AO Komineft and the Ukhtinsk refinery. Komineft is mostly owned by OAO Neftyanaya Kompaniya KomiTEK.
Ministry experts have estimated crude oil reserves in each of the three structures at between 0.5 and 0.7 million tonnes.
